title: Skin delivery and anti-inflammatory effects of the anesthetic propofol against psoriasiform lesions through KEAP1/Nrf2/HO-1 pathway activation.
authors: Yu, Huang-Ping; Yang, Shih-Chun; Lin, Cheng-Yu; Alalaiwe, Ahmed; Yang, Hsiao-Yuan; Fang, Jia-You
journal: Cellular and molecular life sciences : CMLS
one_liner_zh: 该文研究麻醉药丙泊酚经皮递送通过KEAP1/Nrf2/HO-1通路缓解银屑病炎症，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Propofol is a commonly used anesthetic for sedation during surgery. This drug is reported to exhibit nonanaesthetic immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory effects. Herein, we investigated the impact of topical propofol delivery with the aim of mitigating psoriatic inflammation. The antipsoriatic potency of propofol was evaluated in a cell-based study in which keratinocytes, macrophages, and neutrophils were used as models. A significant reduction in the proinflammatory effectors interleukin (IL)-6, IL-8, and CXC motif chemokine ligand (CXCL)1 was found in activated keratinocytes (HaCaT) treated with propofol. This reduction could enable baseline control. Immunoblotting suggested that the antioxidant enzymes nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor (Nrf)2 and heme oxygenase (HO)-1 were involved in the protective effect of propofol on keratinocyte stimulation. The increase in Nrf2 and HO-1 was mediated by kelch-like ECH-associated protein (KEAP)1 downregulation. Propofol presented scavenging activity and decreased 2,2-diphenyl-1-picrylhydrazyl (DPPH) by 47%. The downregulation of cytokines/chemokines in activated macrophages (differentiated THP-1) and mouse neutrophils was also found after propofol treatment. Macrophage migration triggered by the conditioned medium of activated keratinocytes could be blocked with the intervention of propofol. The absorption level of propofol (3 mM) into intact pig skin was 1.2 nmol/mg. Skin deposition was increased to 3.7 nmol/mg after SC lipid removal to mimic psoriasiform skin. In silico molecular docking demonstrated the facile interaction of propofol with ceramides in the stratum corneum (SC). The treatment of imiquimod (IMQ)-sensitized mice with topical propofol suppressed erythema, acanthosis, and macrophage/neutrophil infiltration. Propofol also dramatically decreased cytokine/chemokine levels and epidermal thickness in the lesion. In summary, propofol exhibits anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties to treat psoriasiform lesions. Topical propofol delivery is useful as an ideal route to accomplish antipsoriatic therapy and avoid systemic effects.
abstract_zh: 丙泊酚是一种常用于手术期间镇静的麻醉剂。据报道，该药物具有非麻醉性的免疫调节和抗炎作用。在此，我们研究了局部递送丙泊酚以减轻银屑病炎症的影响。在细胞研究中，以角质形成细胞、巨噬细胞和中性粒细胞为模型，评估了丙泊酚的抗银屑病效力。在经丙泊酚处理的活化角质形成细胞（HaCaT）中，发现促炎效应因子白细胞介素（IL）-6、IL-8 和 CXC 基序趋化因子配体（CXCL）1 显著减少。这种减少可能有助于实现基线控制。免疫印迹分析表明，抗氧化酶核因子红细胞2相关因子（Nrf）2 和血红素加氧酶（HO）-1 参与了丙泊酚对角质形成细胞刺激的保护作用。Nrf2 和 HO-1 的增加是由 kelch 样 ECH 相关蛋白（KEAP）1 的下调介导的。丙泊酚表现出清除活性，使 2,2-二苯基-1-苦基肼（DPPH）降低了 47%。在丙泊酚处理后，活化巨噬细胞（分化的 THP-1）和小鼠中性粒细胞中的细胞因子/趋化因子也出现下调。由活化角质形成细胞条件培养基引发的巨噬细胞迁移可被丙泊酚干预所阻断。丙泊酚（3 mM）在完整猪皮肤中的吸收水平为 1.2 nmol/mg。在去除角质层（SC）脂质以模拟银屑病样皮肤后，皮肤沉积量增加至 3.7 nmol/mg。计算机模拟分子对接表明，丙泊酚与角质层中的神经酰胺易于相互作用。对咪喹莫特（IMQ）致敏小鼠进行局部丙泊酚治疗，抑制了红斑、棘层增厚以及巨噬细胞/中性粒细胞浸润。丙泊酚还显著降低了病变中的细胞因子/趋化因子水平和表皮厚度。总之，丙泊酚表现出抗炎和抗氧化特性，可用于治疗银屑病样病变。局部递送丙泊酚是实现抗银屑病治疗并避免全身效应的理想途径。
